name: TextBox 6
text:
Brief 8: 
How might we train first responders for a mass casualty incident with spatial computing and AI?
textPreview: Brief 8:  | How might we train first responders for a mass casualty incident with spatial computing and AI? |

name: headline
text: Live exercises are essential—but difficult to repeat
textPreview: Live exercises are essential—but difficult to repeat

name: problem-lead
text: Mass-casualty readiness depends on decisions made under pressure: survey the scene, identify hazards, prioritise casualties, coordinate roles, and reassess.
textPreview: Mass-casualty readiness depends on decisions made under pressure: survey the scene, identify hazards, prioritise casualties, coordinate r...

name: problem-body-0
text: Space, actors, equipment, instructors, and reset time.
textPreview: Space, actors, equipment, instructors, and reset time.

name: problem-body-1
text: Every live run varies, making deliberate practice difficult.
textPreview: Every live run varies, making deliberate practice difficult.

name: problem-body-2
text: A final score rarely explains what the learner saw or missed.
textPreview: A final score rarely explains what the learner saw or missed.

alt: First responder mass-casualty training exercise with casualty mannequins

text:
This slide frames the operational training problem without claiming that spatial simulation replaces live exercises.

[Sources]
- Local project: /Users/shreeraj/projects/triagexr/TriageXR/README.md and relevant Swift/relay implementation files.
- User-supplied training photograph: /var/folders/p_/p663ljhn16l7xm3y7c77vgvm0000gp/T/TemporaryItems/NSIRD_screencaptureui_c4iEZ1/Screenshot 2026-08-10 at 10.35.18 AM.png.
[/Sources]

name: headline
text: TriageXR turns a safe room into a dynamic incident
textPreview: TriageXR turns a safe room into a dynamic incident

name: product-lead
text: A native Apple Vision Pro experience trains the decision loop—not physical medical procedures.
textPreview: A native Apple Vision Pro experience trains the decision loop—not physical medical procedures.

name: flow-body-0
text: Turn through four spatial sectors and identify the fuel hazard.
textPreview: Turn through four spatial sectors and identify the fuel hazard.

name: flow-body-1
text: Reach to 3D targets; hand tracking verifies sustained checks.
textPreview: Reach to 3D targets; hand tracking verifies sustained checks.

name: flow-body-2
text: Tag P1, P2, P3, or Expectant from revealed evidence.
textPreview: Tag P1, P2, P3, or Expectant from revealed evidence.

name: flow-body-3
text: Respond when casualty condition and the correct priority change.
textPreview: Respond when casualty condition and the correct priority change.

name: flow-body-4
text: Replay the cue, actor, consequence, and next best action.
textPreview: Replay the cue, actor, consequence, and next best action.

name: demo-band-copy
text: Jordan deteriorates on a meaningful clock while sustained simulated CPR coverage pauses the decline—forcing the team to notice, communicate, and act.
textPreview: Jordan deteriorates on a meaningful clock while sustained simulated CPR coverage pauses the decline—forcing the team to notice, communica...

text:
The experience flow is implemented in the briefing window, immersive space, spatial assessment coordinator, incident engine, and after-action review.

[Sources]
- Local project: /Users/shreeraj/projects/triagexr/TriageXR/README.md and relevant Swift/relay implementation files.
[/Sources]

name: headline
text: A casualty can change—and the learner must notice
textPreview: A casualty can change—and the learner must notice

name: timeline-lead
text: Jordan begins in untreated cardiac arrest. The evidence evolves with elapsed scenario time and sustained team response.
textPreview: Jordan begins in untreated cardiac arrest. The evidence evolves with elapsed scenario time and sustained team response.

name: timeline-body-0
text: Unresponsive, not breathing normally, no palpable pulse.
textPreview: Unresponsive, not breathing normally, no palpable pulse.

name: timeline-body-2
text: Without effective team response, the simulation reaches a fatal outcome.
textPreview: Without effective team response, the simulation reaches a fatal outcome.

name: timeline-body-3
text: Sustained simulated CPR coverage pauses deterioration and becomes replay evidence.
textPreview: Sustained simulated CPR coverage pauses deterioration and becomes replay evidence.

name: timeline-callout-copy
text: The learning objective is not memorising a label. It is seeing new evidence, updating the shared picture, and changing the decision.
textPreview: The learning objective is not memorising a label. It is seeing new evidence, updating the shared picture, and changing the decision.

text:
The 6-minute neurological-risk and 10-minute simulation-outcome thresholds are scenario rules in the repository. They are used for training logic, not presented as a general medical protocol.

[Sources]
- Local project: /Users/shreeraj/projects/triagexr/TriageXR/README.md and relevant Swift/relay implementation files.
[/Sources]

name: headline
text: Spatial, shared, and explainable by design
textPreview: Spatial, shared, and explainable by design

name: architecture-lead
text: Three connected systems turn immersive interaction into reliable training evidence.
textPreview: Three connected systems turn immersive interaction into reliable training evidence.

name: architecture-body-0
text: Sector beacons and casualty-specific 3D targets verify what the trainee physically inspected.
textPreview: Sector beacons and casualty-specific 3D targets verify what the trainee physically inspected.

name: architecture-body-1
text: One host owns the clock and scene state; role permissions and targeted commands keep teams aligned.
textPreview: One host owns the clock and scene state; role permissions and targeted commands keep teams aligned.

name: architecture-body-2
text: The score stays deterministic. AI coaching must cite exact replay event IDs or it is rejected.
textPreview: The score stays deterministic. AI coaching must cite exact replay event IDs or it is rejected.

name: architecture-footer
text: Works offline with deterministic local coaching; the optional AI relay adds grounded narrative without becoming a single point of failure.
textPreview: Works offline with deterministic local coaching; the optional AI relay adds grounded narrative without becoming a single point of failure.

text:
Architecture is grounded in SpatialAssessmentCoordinator.swift, IncidentCollaboration.swift, Core/TriageDomain.swift, AICoachService.swift, and relay/src/worker.js.

[Sources]
- Local project: /Users/shreeraj/projects/triagexr/TriageXR/README.md and relevant Swift/relay implementation files.
[/Sources]

name: headline
text: We measure how teams think—not just what they clicked
textPreview: We measure how teams think—not just what they clicked

name: diff-body-0
text: Findings unlock only after a sustained pose at the correct spatial target.
textPreview: Findings unlock only after a sustained pose at the correct spatial target.

name: diff-body-1
text: Incident commander, triage, airway, and instructor roles have explicit responsibilities and permissions.
textPreview: Incident commander, triage, airway, and instructor roles have explicit responsibilities and permissions.

name: diff-body-2
text: Each material action preserves the visible cue, responsible role, consequence, and reconstructed scene.
textPreview: Each material action preserves the visible cue, responsible role, consequence, and reconstructed scene.

name: diff-body-3
text: Coaching is grounded in verified event IDs and cannot alter the deterministic 100-point score.
textPreview: Coaching is grounded in verified event IDs and cannot alter the deterministic 100-point score.

text:
Differentiators are implemented capabilities. The deck does not claim improved clinical outcomes or replacement of certified practical training.

[Sources]
- Local project: /Users/shreeraj/projects/triagexr/TriageXR/README.md and relevant Swift/relay implementation files.
[/Sources]

name: headline
text: The complete training loop already runs end to end
textPreview: The complete training loop already runs end to end

name: proof-lead
text: Built natively for visionOS, with deterministic tests and a stage-ready simulator path.
textPreview: Built natively for visionOS, with deterministic tests and a stage-ready simulator path.

name: proof-band-copy
text: Survey → assess → coordinate → watch Jordan change → finish → replay the exact decision trail. Demo 8× compresses scenario deterioration while keeping the responder hold interaction in real time.

text:
